note: Measured, not asserted. Scoped lowering of one W460X60 out of a real multi-storey IFC2X3 model. The body IS a complete swept solid, so the adapter can derive Zx from geometry -- but the beam carries no GAT_Structural property set, so no yield strength enters the world and no AISC capacity slot is synthesized. Capacity therefore cannot be checked from the model alone; it needs a material certificate. Digests identify the model's bytes, so this record reproduces wherever the corpus is fetched to.
